scope: Read-only source, Git-object, filesystem and hash inventory followed by writing this new inventory. No proof, binary compatibility, axiom closure or actual import/build execution was checked.
entry_gate_reasons: The exact Lean4Lean target checkout is absent from the inspected locations and the target commit object is absent from the existing donor checkout.
Ten selected Lean4Lean theory/verification/support modules and fourteen Batteries modules in the explicit source import closure lack compiled .olean files.
An isolated target-source/dependency environment and complete build/import closure have not been materialized or validated.

alternate_source_only_tree.limitation: Source-only extracted older revision; not an exact target checkout or ready proof runtime.

candidate_proof_dependency_boundary.status: Candidate static dependency boundary only. Complete transitive theorem assumptions and sorryAx absence require later checked axiom reporting.
candidate_proof_dependency_boundary.excluded_claim: Imports alone do not prove that an axiom is a theorem dependency or establish its absence.
candidate_proof_dependency_boundary.shared_runtime_trust: A later proof uses the installed Lean kernel/elaborator and imported libraries as its proof runtime; it is not independent validation of that runtime or evidence of executable-validator refinement.

allowed_operations: git show of an observed blob
SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1 computation
source_closure_algorithm: Start at Lean4Lean.Verify.Level. Read matching source files in the donor for Lean4Lean modules and its exact Batteries checkout for Batteries modules.
Recursively match source lines with ^(?:public\s+|private\s+)?import\s+(?:all\s+)?([\w.]+). This is an explicit source-import inventory, not Lean elaboration.
For each module, inspect .lake/build/lib/lean/<module path>.olean. For core imports, inspect the installed toolchain lib/lean/<module path>.olean and stop recursion there.
Compute SHA-256 over raw file bytes. For target correspondence compute SHA-1 over b"blob " + decimal byte length + NUL + raw bytes and compare with the retained target tree entry.
Check each CVC-1 I1/I4 receipt file against its work-record.json byte length and SHA-256.
Read the exact target manifest using git show on the observed pinned-tree blob, verify its Git blob SHA-1, and retain its raw text.
limitations: The directory search is bounded to recorded locations, not a proof that no alternate runtime exists anywhere on the host.
The import parser inventories explicit import lines; it does not establish all build-system, native, platform or transitive core-runtime requirements.
No compiled result or theorem proof was reproduced.
